# Loopp Refund Policy

This policy explains when Loopp issues refunds. It is rendered directly from the rule data that drives our automated eligibility checks, so the rules below are exactly the rules the system enforces.

## 1. Return window

Items are eligible for a refund for 30 days after delivery. Requests made after the window closes are declined.

## 2. Delivered orders only

Refunds are only issued for orders that have been delivered. Orders still processing, in transit, or cancelled are not eligible.

## 3. Final-sale items

Items marked as final sale are not eligible for a refund.

## 4. Partial refunds

Refunds are assessed per item. Eligible items in an order are refunded even when other items in the same order do not qualify.

## 5. Shipping charges

Shipping charges are non-refundable. Refunds cover the purchase price of eligible items only.

## 6. One refund per item

An item can be refunded only once. Items already covered by a processed refund or an open escalation cannot be refunded again.

## 7. High-value refund review

Refunds totaling more than $500.00 are escalated to a human specialist for review before any money is paid out.

## 8. Original payment method

Refunds are always issued to the original payment method used for the order — never to a different card, account, or store credit.
